allometry.note: Rough heights from general knowledge of the species: clumps up to about 6 m up its host at 20 years. Wide tolerances.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye from photographs: olive-brown stems, pink-red berries.

appearance.organs.fruit.shape.kind.note: How PlantGen lays out an inflorescence, a choice of the model's (spec rework L1): the inflorescence characters set the cluster of any look a taxon draws as one (`"inflorescence": {}`), its kind, how many units it bears on each axis, its primary branches and how it holds itself. Sizes, stalks and spacing stay set by hand until programs size their organs from characters.

generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: a leafless parasitic shrub of the Sonoran Desert that hangs in tangled clumps of jointed, olive to reddish stems up to a metre across from mesquite, palo verde, ironwood and acacia, with small translucent pink-red berries spread by phainopeplas. Not fitted to measurements.

generator.params.dioecious.note: How PlantGen draws the sexes, a choice of the model's (dioecy, 2026-10-14): a plant bears both sexes, unless its taxa state it dioecious.

generator.params.sex.note: How PlantGen draws the sexes, a choice of the model's (dioecy, 2026-10-14): a plant's sex is its own draw, dealt across a package's seeds so that both sexes grow; the typical plant (sex 0.5) is female, so it shows its fruit.

generator.program.note: The lineage's own program (growth plan G2.3a), on the epiphyte base: it gives the values the epiphyte program gave as defaults until then.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

host.note: The host the spec's authors chose for this guest, grown at the age, environment and seed given.

taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

provenance.notes: Procedural proxy (plant forms milestone F7). Calibration against measurements and photographs comes later.
